subject: MSA / Order Form: onboarding & evidence playbook for HealthSync
messages:
From: Mark Chen <mark.chen@healthsync.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <procurement@healthsync.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthSync onboarding - evidence cadence and pen test language

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and security asked us for a compact onboarding plan so they can finalize the PO. Two asks from my side to confirm before we move to your order form: 

1) SOC 2: we require either a current SOC 2 Type II or an SOC 2 attestation within 90 days of go-live. Can you confirm what you provide and whether you will commit to share the report under NDA?

2) Pen test / inspection rights: we need clarity on the language in the MSA around penetration testing and evidence access. Our security team prefers an "inspection window + sample evidence" approach rather than full continuous access. They also want explicit timing (e.g., a 2-week staging window quarterly) and a point of contact for scheduling.

I attached our short security questionnaire to this email to speed up mapping. If you have a proposed redline for the MSA/order form that captures the inspection window, evidence cadence, and liability carveouts, please send it over — legal will review quickly if the language is prescriptive.

Goal: sign order form and start onboarding 2 weeks after contract execution.

Thanks,
Mark
Security Program Manager
HealthSync

Attachments:
- HealthSync_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mark Chen <mark.chen@healthsync.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <procurement@healthsync.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthSync onboarding - evidence cadence and pen test language

Hi Mark — really appreciate the clear asks and the questionnaire. Attaching a short MSA redline and a pen-test policy excerpt that reflect our standard production approach. High level answers below, then I flagged where we need legal review/redline adjustments.

SOC 2:
- We provide a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month period) under NDA; for new customers we can share a bridge letter if a fresh report is pending.
- Proposed order form clause: "Customer may request Provider's most recent SOC 2 Type II report; Provider will deliver the report subject to NDA within 7 business days of request."

Pen test / inspection rights (proposed):
- Bounded staging window: Provider offers a scheduled staging window (up to 10 business days per 12-month period) for deep inspection/penetration testing.
- Evidence cadence: Quarterly evidence packages (sample logs, SOC controls artifacts) plus an ad-hoc evidence response for prioritized requests with a 10-business-day SLA.
- Non-production testing: redlines prefer no live-production destructive testing and a reciprocal notification + escalation path.

Notes for legal: we avoid open-ended "inspection rights" language (they're hard for multi-tenant hosted). Instead we provide:
- A clear staging window and list of artifacts we can deliver
- A limitation on scope for customer-initiated pen tests in hosted environments (we can provide test reports from our third-party pentesters and support white-box exercises in staging)

I attached: "proposed_msa_redline.docx" and "pen-test-policy.pdf" (short excerpt).

Next steps: Karthik — can you confirm if the 10-business-day evidence SLA is acceptable operationally and whether we can offer an additional 2-business-day expedited route for legal/contract sign-off requests?

Mark / Priya — if the staging window / evidence cadence looks reasonable I can loop in LA counsel to convert the redline into final language. Happy to take a 30-minute call to walk through specifics.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- proposed_msa_redline.docx (redline excerpt)
- pen-test-policy.pdf (policy excerpt)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@healthsync.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthSync onboarding - evidence cadence and pen test language

Thanks Vanessa — quick operational confirmation from infra/ops:

- 10 business days per year for a bounded staging window: OK for scheduling, but we propose "up to 14 calendar days spread across a 30-calendar-day window" (gives flexibility for customer to run different engagement types).
- Evidence cadence: quarterly package ok. We can commit to a 10-business-day SLA for standard requests; for expedited requests we can offer a 3-business-day SLA if HealthSync signs an expedited evidence addendum (template provided).
- Pen test in production: we cannot approve intrusive testing against live production for hosted customers. We will:
  * Support third-party pentest reports (we'll provide the findings from our vendor and a remediation plan), or
  * Provide a staging environment with representative data where customers may conduct tests within the agreed staging window.

Operational ask: need to map the exact artifact list (logs, config snapshots, SOC control references). Suggest we add a short appendix listing deliverables per evidence package. I added comments in the proposed_msa_redline.docx.

If legal is comfortable with the expedited SLA language we can include an optional addendum in the order form for customers that need faster turnaround.

-Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Operations

Attachment referenced:
- (comments in) proposed_msa_redline.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mark Chen <mark.chen@healthsync.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthSync onboarding - evidence cadence and pen test language

Hi all — looping in from Legal. Appreciate the proposal; a few legal edits and clarifications below. I captured them inline and summarized the key contract bullets we need to agree before signature: 

1) SOC 2 exchange: we will provide Provider's most recent SOC 2 Type II under NDA. Add clause: "Provider may redact limited sensitive infrastructure information; Provider will not unreasonably withhold the report."

2) Inspection / Pen test language: suggest the following compromise language for MSA (summary):
- "Provider will permit Customer-brokered penetration testing using Provider-vetted vendors in a mutually-agreed staging environment, within a scheduled testing window not to exceed 14 calendar days per 12-month period. Provider will not authorize destructive testing against multi-tenant production environments."
- Add a scheduling SLA: requests submitted >= 30 days prior; Provider will confirm window within 10 business days of request.

3) Evidence cadence and artifacts: attach Appendix B to the Order Form listing sample artifacts (control mappings, sample logs, retention screenshots). We will keep the standard 10-business-day SLA for standard evidence packages and include an optional "expedite" fee/addendum for 3-business-day turnaround.

4) Data access and confidentiality: add explicit statement that evidence shared for review remains Provider confidential and must be used only for security validation under NDA; prohibit customer from sharing raw logs externally.

I'll incorporate these points into the redline and re-export a clean DOCX for Mark/Priya to review. Vanessa — please confirm whether HealthSync needs the expedited addendum template now or we can hold until legal mark-up is in place.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Forwarded attachments (in updated redline):
- proposed_msa_redline_final.docx (will send within 24 hours)
- Appendix_B_artifact_list.pdf (artifact checklist)
